_comment: Machine-readable service dependency graph. Updated: 2026-05-13. Version: 0.0.53

_legend.sync-http: Synchronous HTTP call via internal API (X-Service-Token auth, circuit-breaker protected)
_legend.cross-db-view: Direct SQL cross-database view JOIN via TypeORM (DEPRECATED — being replaced by sync-http)
_legend.proxy: Gateway reverse proxy (no direct service coupling)

gateway.notes: Pure reverse proxy. No business logic. Routes by URL prefix.

users.notes: Source of truth for all identity and role capability data.

cross_db_views.status: DEPRECATED — will be replaced by sync-http enrichment

ticketing.notes: Ticketing service has the most cross-DB view dependencies. Phase A decoupling will remove entity imports; Phase H will add async cache invalidation events.

cross_db_views.status: DEPRECATED — will be replaced by sync-http enrichment

compliance.notes: Compliance service also directly injects User/Unit TypeORM entities — tracked as violation C1 in ARCHITECTURE-AUDIT-v2.md. Phase A decoupling will remove these.

known_violations.C1: Cross-boundary TypeORM entity imports (tickets, documents, kpi modules import User/Unit/RoleCapability entities from users module source)
known_violations.C2: RoleCapabilitiesService TypeScript code compiled into ticketing and compliance binaries alongside users-service
known_violations.C3: Circuit breaker added in v0.0.51 — RESOLVED
known_violations.H1: Cross-DB SQL views still primary JOIN mechanism for entity hydration

remediation_phases.A: Entity decoupling — replace cross-boundary entity classes with UserRef/UnitRef value objects
remediation_phases.B: RoleCapabilitiesHttpClient — replace RoleCapabilitiesService DB reads with HTTP call to /api/internal/role-capabilities
remediation_phases.H: Async event bus — Redis pub/sub for user lifecycle and capability change events
